name: linkerd
smoke:
"$OFFLINE_PREFIX/bin/linkerd" inject --ignore-cluster - <<'YAML' > /tmp/linkerd-injected.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: offline
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: offline}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: offline}
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        image: example.invalid/app:1
YAML
grep -q linkerd.io/inject /tmp/linkerd-injected.yaml
notes: Converts the official upstream installer; upstream source is fetched at a fixed commit rather than vendored.
Pins the upstream edge release. Validates local manifest processing; no cluster install or Kubernetes API access is included.

validation_scope.runtime_scope: CLI installation and local operation; no remote service, cluster or deployment is claimed.
